picks.title: China's open-weight Kimi model stuns AI world with frontier-level results
picks.why_it_matters: A Chinese startup releasing frontier-level open-weight models at lower cost could dramatically shift AI infrastructure economics and create new opportunities for startups building on top of open models.

picks.title: Ultrahuman's former hardware VP raises $5.5M for devices that control AI agents, not just record you
picks.why_it_matters: Early-stage seed round signals emerging category of AI-agent hardware interfaces—a potential platform shift as agents move from software to physical interaction layers.

picks.title: AI godfathers converge on regulations
picks.why_it_matters: Alignment among major AI labs on regulatory frameworks could shape compliance burdens and market access rules that early-stage AI startups will need to navigate.
